items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: When T-Boy had the band, Cornish wasn't in the band.

ctx.x: Sometimes Ray played the trombone. And when he didn't, then we'd use what you call them on the bass. But then after getting Ray on the bass, Warner played trombone and then we'd use what you call them on the bass. Warner played trombone and I can't call his name, but he played trombone, had two trombone players.
One time Carnish was in the band. No. That was earlier.
Yeah. That's a long time ago, but I'm talking about lately. When T-Boy had the band, Cornish wasn't in the band.
